schema: DecisionBench-DD experimental_validation_panel v1.0 (amended v1.1, corrected v1.1.1)
status: frozen before any wet-lab data exists -- see experimental_validation_panel_v1.0.md for full narrative and rationale
v1_1_amendment_summary: External review caught a mechanistic self-contradiction: v1.0's Tier 1 gate required GCase 'activation' at neutral pH while this same document's pH-dependence-hypothesis section already described Ambroxol as a pH-dependent INHIBITOR. Fixed: assay 3 replaced by a binding/stabilization assay (3a) plus a sign-agnostic catalytic-modulation assay (3b, reporting inhibition IC50 and/or activation EC50 plus a pH-selectivity ratio); the tier_1_to_tier_2 gate now requires neutral-pH engagement of either sign plus acceptable acidic-pH residual activity, not activation specifically. Compound membership (Tranche 1/Tranche 2) is unchanged -- the review confirmed this partition as defensible.
v1_1_1_correction_summary: External review of v1.1 confirmed panel membership/architecture as acceptable and found 8 further pre-data corrections, all applied: (1) Ambroxol recharacterized as mixed-type, not competitive, inhibitor (Maegawa et al. explicitly reports mixed-type inhibition); (2) N370S and N409S are the SAME variant (GBA1 c.1226A>G, p.Asn409Ser) under legacy vs. HGVS numbering, not two candidate variants -- every occurrence corrected; (3) section 3a's statistical pre-registration now specifies concrete default values, not just a checklist of categories; (4) the Tier1->Tier2 cytotoxicity gate now branches for stabilization-only vs. catalytic-modulator candidates, previously undefined for the former; (5) the overall-pass criteria's 'ALL required' claim contradicted describing hepatocyte stability as non-excluding -- resolved by moving it to an explicit optimization flag outside the mandatory set; (6) PAMPA-BBB (passive-only) is now explicitly separated from a required MDCK-MDR1/BCRP-competent transporter-efflux assay; (7) the 30x hERG index must now come from validated patch-clamp, not thallium-flux triage, and 'GBA1-specific lysosomal activity' is now operationally defined (CBE-inhibitable fraction); (8) this document's own v1.1 amendment date was mislabeled one day into the future -- corrected to real UTC timestamps, and the companion README's stale docking-outputs sentence and patent-membership wording were also fixed.
relationship_to_computational_funnel: All 16 primary candidate_screen_results/summary.md passers remain qualified and unchanged. This selects a first experimental tranche of 6 for practical reasons; the other 10 are an explicit Tranche 2 reserve, not excluded.

tranche_1_panel.selection_rationale: CNNaffinity 7.017, ligand-efficiency proxy 0.351, no invalid ADMET predictions -- balanced relative to the rest of the panel, not 'clean': predicted hERG (0.766) remains elevated and must still be tracked.
Highest CNNaffinity of all 16 primary passers (7.370); tests whether top computational affinity translates to real potency despite weaker predicted solubility/clearance.

The sole MolMIM passer -- kept in the experimental funnel to represent that chemotype, but n=1 cannot support a statistically meaningful generator-level (GenMol-vs-MolMIM) efficacy comparison; any result is a single data point about this compound only.
Smallest, most Ambroxol-proximal analogue (MW 392, cLogP 3.43) in the panel; a mechanistic bridge to the reference compound.

Second-highest CNNaffinity (7.060) but near-zero pH-sensitivity delta (-0.028) -- included to directly challenge the pH-dependence hypothesis with a compound predicted NOT to fit it, not a validated negative control (no data exist yet to validate anything against). Also has the panel's invalid (negative) predicted hepatocyte clearance, making it the priority case for real metabolic-stability data.

Lowest hERG (0.352) and AMES (0.126) risk of the panel, plus the single largest neutral-vs-acidic CNNaffinity delta of all 16 candidates (+0.935) -- strongest computational candidate for genuine Ambroxol-like pH-dependent chaperone behavior, traded off against reduced predicted BBB/HIA.

target_variant.note: N370S (legacy, mature-protein numbering) and N409S (HGVS, includes the 39-residue signal peptide) name the SAME single substitution, not two candidate variants -- v1.1's 'N370S (and/or N409S)' phrasing was corrected in v1.1.1.

compound_identity_freeze_requirements: Exact stereoisomer synthesized/procured, or explicit racemic/diastereomeric-mixture statement (canonical SMILES here do not specify absolute stereochemistry).
Purity threshold (e.g. >=95%) and analytical method used to confirm it.
LC-MS mass confirmation and NMR structural-identity records, archived per compound.
Stock solvent, concentration, and maximum final DMSO percentage per assay.

ambroxol.note: Seed compound; mixed-type, pH-dependent GCase inhibitor acutely (more potent near neutral pH), and a separate cellular pharmacological chaperone -- see v1_1_1_correction_summary.

isofagomine_ifm.note: Active-site chaperone reference (redocking benchmark's own reference ligand, PDB 3GXF); distinguishes 'any chaperone effect' from an Ambroxol-like allosteric/pH-dependent effect.

vehicle.note: DMSO, matched to test-compound stock concentration, in every cell-based and biochemical assay.

assay_specific_positive_controls.note: hERG blocker, CYP substrate, etc. -- left to the executing lab's own validated protocols/vendor, not specified by this project.

tier_1.run_on: all 6 Tranche 1 candidates + Ambroxol + IFM + vehicle

assays.name: analytical_solubility
assays.conditions: pH 7.4 and pH 5.0; LC-UV/LC-MS confirmed concentration, not nephelometry alone

assays.name: gcase_binding_stabilization
assays.conditions: thermal-shift/nanoDSF or heat-inactivation protection, purified recombinant GBA1 p.Asn409Ser (legacy N370S) GCase (not lysate), neutral pH
assays.priority_case: all -- tests chaperone-binding mechanism independent of catalytic-effect sign

assays.name: gcase_signed_catalytic_modulation
assays.conditions: 4-MUG with taurocholate, standardized alkaline stop, compound-only fluorescence controls, dose-response at pH 7.4 and pH 5.0, purified recombinant enzyme; sign-agnostic curve fitting (inhibition IC50 and/or activation EC50, residual activity, maximal signed effect, pH-selectivity ratio IC50(acidic)/IC50(neutral) for inhibitors); orthogonal natural-substrate confirmation required for finalists
assays.priority_case: all -- direct experimental analogue of delta_cnnaffinity_neutral_minus_acidic

tier_2.run_on: only candidates passing the tier_1_to_tier_2 gate

assays.name: cellular_chaperone_rescue
assays.conditions: GBA1 p.Asn409Ser/p.Asn409Ser (legacy N370S/N370S) patient-derived fibroblasts (primary model; engineered line is secondary/assay-development only); primary endpoint = GBA1-specific (CBE-inhibitable-fraction or equivalent) lysosomal activity after washout; secondary = mature/Endo-H-resistant abundance + lysosomal localization; multi-dose, fixed duration, washout before lysate measurement; donor/genotype/passage/authentication/mycoplasma status and exact durations frozen in the executing lab's SOP annex

assays.name: herg_counterscreen
assays.conditions: thallium-flux is TRIAGE ONLY (selects which compounds proceed to patch-clamp); the 30x hERG index (see decision_gates.overall_pass) must be computed from a validated automated- or manual-patch-clamp IC50, never from the triage signal
assays.priority_case: GM_054 (0.919), GM_034 (0.857); GM_057 (0.352) is the lowest-predicted-risk comparator

assays.name: metabolic_stability
assays.conditions: human liver microsomes AND cryopreserved hepatocytes in parallel, LC-MS/MS
assays.priority_case: GM_054 (invalid/negative predicted hepatocyte clearance -- needs real data to resolve)

assays.name: permeability_oral_cns_passive_and_efflux
assays.conditions: Caco-2 bidirectional (oral/intestinal, Papp + efflux ratio); PAMPA-BBB (CNS PASSIVE permeability ONLY -- no transporters present, cannot yield an efflux ratio); MDCK-MDR1 (P-gp efflux ratio) AND a BCRP-competent or dual-transfected MDCK-MDR1/BCRP system (BCRP efflux ratio) -- three/four distinct measurements, never conflated
assays.priority_case: GM_057 (BBB=0.540, HIA=0.784, both lowest in panel) -- priority across all permeability/efflux assays

assays.name: neuronal_validation
assays.conditions: e.g. patient-iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons or equivalent -- out of this document's scope; requires its own frozen protocol before execution

tier_1_to_tier_2.solubility: analytically-confirmed concentration within 3x of nominal test concentration (assay 1)
tier_1_to_tier_2.therapeutic_index: branch-aware (v1.1.1 fix): catalytic modulators (assay 3b yields a fitted IC50/EC50) require CC50 (assay 2) >= 10x that value at the more potent pH; stabilization-only candidates (positive assay 3a signal, no fitted 3b value) require CC50 >= 10x the stabilization assay's effective concentration, or >= 10x the max planned assay-4 exposure concentration if that is not well-defined
tier_1_to_tier_2.engagement: neutral-pH engagement or stabilization (positive assay 3a signal, OR a defined minimum inhibitory/activating potency in assay 3b at pH 7.4) PLUS acceptable residual catalytic activity at acidic pH (assay 3b at pH 5.0) -- corrected in v1.1 from requiring neutral-pH activation specifically; does not presuppose the sign of the acute effect; 'positive'/'defined minimum'/'acceptable' are quantified via statistical_preregistration's minimum_effect_size
tier_1_to_tier_2.rule: ALL must be satisfied to advance a compound to tier 2

mandatory.chaperone_rescue: positive in patient-derived cells (assay 4 primary endpoint, post-washout), not just Tier 1 biochemical engagement
mandatory.herg_discovery_index: hERG IC50 from VALIDATED PATCH-CLAMP (assay 5) >= 30x cellular EC50 (assay 4) -- renamed in v1.1 from 'hERG safety margin': an early-discovery hERG-to-cellular-efficacy index, NOT a regulatory safety margin (regulatory interpretation requires projected unbound systemic exposure, which does not exist yet); must not be computed from the thallium-flux triage signal (v1.1.1 fix)
mandatory.permeability: oral (Caco-2 Papp), CNS passive (PAMPA-BBB Pe), AND CNS transporter efflux (MDCK-MDR1 P-gp ratio + BCRP-competent system ratio) all above the executing lab's own validated in-house cutoffs (assay 7) -- illustrative starting defaults: Caco-2 Papp(A-to-B) > 2e-6 cm/s with efflux ratio < 2; PAMPA-BBB Pe above the specific kit/vendor's own 'CNS+' cutoff -- confirm against the validated assay actually in use

optimization_flag_not_mandatory.metabolic_stability: human hepatocyte t1/2 >= 30 minutes (assay 6) -- v1.1.1 fix: moved out of the mandatory ALL-pass set (v1.1 contradicted itself by requiring 'ALL' while also calling this non-excluding) into an explicit, tracked flag; below-bar compounds are not excluded on this criterion alone but are flagged for metabolism-focused follow-up

overall_pass.rule: ALL of the mandatory criteria (chaperone_rescue, herg_discovery_index, permeability) must be satisfied to prioritize a compound beyond this panel into tier 3 or a synthesis-scale-up decision; the optimization flag is reported and tracked but does not gate this decision

statistical_preregistration.replicate_counts: n=3 independent biological replicates (separate passage/enzyme-prep/compound-dilution), each in n=3 technical replicates, for every assay in section 2
statistical_preregistration.randomization_and_blinding: compound identity coded on every plate map; plate position randomized per biological replicate
statistical_preregistration.curve_fitting_model_and_acceptance_crite: four-parameter logistic, Hill slope floating (constrained to 1.0 on non-convergence, and reported which was used); R-squared >= 0.90 required for a reportable IC50/EC50, else reported as 'not determinable'
statistical_preregistration.minimum_effect_size: >=20% change from vehicle for catalytic-modulation/cellular-rescue readouts; >=2 degrees C delta-Tm for the thermal-shift/stabilization readout
statistical_preregistration.confidence_interval_and_alpha: 95% CI, alpha = 0.05, two-sided, for every significance claim referenced by the decision gates
statistical_preregistration.multiple_comparison_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction across compound-by-condition comparisons within each assay
statistical_preregistration.outlier_and_assay_failure_rules: plate-level Z'-factor >= 0.5 required to use a plate (biochemical assays); ROUT or Grubbs' test (alpha=0.05) for technical-replicate outliers, applied identically to all compounds and controls
statistical_preregistration.note: v1.1 listed these as categories to specify; v1.1.1 specifies the actual default values, still adjustable per amendment_policy but no longer an open checklist.

ph_dependence_hypothesis.statement: Ambroxol is a pH-dependent, MIXED-TYPE inhibitor of GCase acutely (more potent near neutral pH, much less potent at acidic/lysosomal pH) and separately increases lysosomal GCase abundance/activity in cells via a slower chaperone mechanism -- corrected in v1.1 from a same-signed 'activation' framing, and in v1.1.1 from 'competitive' to 'mixed-type' inhibition (Maegawa et al. explicitly reports mixed-type kinetics).
ph_dependence_hypothesis.computational_status_being_tested: candidate_screen_results/summary.json: ph_sensitivity_endpoint_status = exploratory_unvalidated (3/4 docking controls disagreed with Ambroxol's own direction) -- this experimental panel, not the docking proxy, is what would actually validate or refute the hypothesis.

amendment_policy: Same rule as every other frozen artifact in this project: compound membership in Tranche 1, the assay list, and decision-gate thresholds may not be changed after any wet-lab result exists for this panel. A gate may be revised only for a documented technical reason discovered during assay development, logged with rationale and a made_before_seeing_results flag -- exactly the discipline used for both the v1.1 and v1.1.1 amendments, made entirely pre-data. No compound may be added to or dropped from Tranche 1 because of assay performance.
scope_limits: This project has no wet lab and executes none of these assays -- this is a specification, not a report of work performed.
No numeric value in this file or its companion .md is a real measurement; all are placeholders/priors from the computational pipeline.

The Maegawa et al. IC50 figures in the companion .md's amendment log are reproduced from external review's citation, not independently re-derived; consult the primary source before using them to size any assay.

Decision-gate thresholds (including the statistical_preregistration defaults and the illustrative permeability cutoffs) are reasonable field defaults, not validated against this specific chemotype or target.
